newsitem.title: USA: 3M backs Q2 EPS consensus of $1.03.
newsitem.headline: 3M backs Q2 EPS consensus of $1.03.

text.p: Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co said Tuesday it backs analysts' consensus estimates for 1997 second quarter earnings of $1.03 a share and for 1997 year earnings of $4.11.
In the 1996 second quarter, 3M reported earnings of $0.91 and for the 1996 year, earnings amounted to $3.63.
At the company's annual shareholders' meeting, 3M Chairman and Chief Executive L.D. DeSimone said he was comfortable with the First Call consensus forecast for the second quarter and for the year.
"We have no reason to give any different guidance," DeSimone said after adjourning the meeting attended by nearly 4,000 people.
